prompt: Implement the two stubbed functions in money.go for a payments service. FormatMinorUnits(amount int64, currency string) string: render a minor-unit amount as a plain decimal string using ISO 4217 exponents — 2 decimals default, 0 for JPY/KRW/VND, 3 for KWD/BHD/OMR; negative amounts keep a leading minus; e.g. (12345,"INR")="123.45", (500,"JPY")="500", (12345,"KWD")="12.345", (5,"USD")="0.05", (-70,"USD")="-0.70". Currency codes are case-insensitive. CountriesForCurrency(currency string) []string: return ISO country codes for AED=[AE], SAR=[SA], KWD=[KW], INR=[IN], GBP=[GB], USD=[US], EUR=[DE FR IT ES NL] (that exact order), unknown=empty non-nil slice; case-insensitive. Run go test ./... to check.
